steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all required items with catalog numbers: 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes (Astik’s, PCRP-015-500), pipette tips (TIPP-1K0-10K, TIPP-200-10K, TIPP-010-10K), peat moss (L1070K0600), vermiculite (100M1006), plastic alveolus tray (4400000S28), cling film (KING756046), aluminum foil (293-4176), mortar and pestle (MORN-075-001), tweezers (FORS-003-002), micro spatula (SPNS-150-005), 15 mL screw‑cap centrifuge tubes (PTGP-E15-025), ND11 crimp neck vials (548-8008A) and caps (548-8004A), 0.2 µm PTFE syringe filters (17573-ACK), DB‑5MS UI GC column (122-5562UI), chemicals: SDS (A2263.0100), sodium hypochlorite (212297.1211), methanol (20864.32), mandelonitrile (116025), absolute ethanol (20821.365), acetonitrile (83639.320), MSTFA (1.11805), silicone oil (24610.363), and autoclaved distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare sterilization solution
steps.instruction: Make Arabidopsis seed sterilization solution containing 1 % SDS and 5 % sodium hypochlorite.

steps.title: Sterilize Arabidopsis seeds
steps.instruction: Place ~80 Col‑0 seeds in a 1.5 mL tube, add 1 mL 70 % ethanol, invert 2 min, remove ethanol, add 1 mL sterilization solution, invert 12 min, remove solution, wash five times with autoclaved distilled water, then keep seeds in water until use.

steps.title: Sow seeds in peat‑vermiculite mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a plastic seed tray with autoclaved peat moss:vermiculite (2:1) for 20 alveoli (6 × 6 × 8 cm). Place five sterilized seeds per alveolus avoiding corners, cover with plastic film, and stratify at 4 °C for 5 days.

steps.title: Grow seedlings
steps.instruction: Transfer the stratified tray to a growth chamber set to 23 ± 1 °C, >70 % relative humidity, 16 h light/8 h dark, and grow plants for 2–3 weeks.

steps.title: Infest plants with spider mites
steps.instruction: Divide plants into control and infestation groups. Place 20 adult female T. urticae on each plant, cover rosettes with ventilated plastic cups, incubate 24 h at 25 ± 1 °C, >70 % RH, 16 h/8 h photoperiod, then remove cups, cut rosettes, freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Extract mandelonitrile
steps.instruction: Grind frozen plant material to a fine powder with liquid nitrogen, weigh ≥100 mg, add 3 mL methanol in a small mortar, homogenize, transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube, sonicate 20 min at room temperature, incubate 60 °C for 10 min, centrifuge 11 500 × g for 5 min at room temperature, collect supernatant in a 10 mL flask, and evaporate methanol on a rotary evaporator at 50 °C until completely dry.

steps.title: Derivatize samples with MSTFA
steps.instruction: Weigh 50 µL mandelonitrile into a 10 mL flask for the standard curve, add 100 µL MSTFA to each mandelonitrile standard and to each Col‑0 extract, mix, incubate 60 °C in an oil bath for 30 min protected from light, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare mandelonitrile standard curve
steps.instruction: Prepare derivatized mandelonitrile standards in acetonitrile at concentrations of 2.5, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, and 500 ng µL⁻¹ using 5 mL vials.

steps.title: Prepare samples for GC analysis
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL acetonitrile to each derivatized Col‑0 sample, filter samples and standards through a 0.2 µm PTFE syringe filter, and place filtrates into ND11 crimp neck vials.

steps.title: Run GC‑MS analysis
steps.instruction: Inject 1 µL of each standard or sample into a DB‑5MS UI column (60 m × 0.25 mm, 0.25 µm film) at 17.7 psi, septum purge flow 3 mL min⁻¹, splitless time 1.5 min; set injector to 250 °C, oven program 60 °C (hold 3 min) then ramp 10 °C min⁻¹ to 300 °C (hold 6 min); transfer line 280 °C; collision gas N₂ at 1.5 mL min⁻¹, quench gas He at 2.25 mL min⁻¹; electron ionization mode 280 °C, 70 eV, using MRM for ion transitions.
